title: N59: US VIX predicts international VaR violations — AUC 0.80-0.86 (lower than SPY 0.93)
description: Tested US VIX/GARCH ratio as predictor for non-US equity VaR violations (EEM, EWG, EWJ, 2020-2025). AUC: EEM 0.855, EWG 0.804, EWJ 0.823 (vs SPY 0.929). Violations at ratio>1.5: 55-65% (vs SPY 91%). US VIX is a useful but imperfect global risk indicator. Implication: Hybrid VT using US VIX could partially work for international equities, but local implied vol indices (if available) would be better. The VIX/GARCH ratio's predictive power decays with distance from US market.
